newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines August load factor up.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines August load factor up.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said Thursday its August load factor was 78.6 percent, up from 76.3 percent a year ago.

Available seat miles for the month were 14.52 billion, compared to 14.33 billion a year ago, United said. Revenue passenger miles were 11.41 billion, compared to 10.93 billion a year ago, the company said.
For 1996 through August, load factor was 72.6 percent, up from 71.0 percent a year ago, United said.
Available seat miles were 108.02 billion, compared to 105.22 billion a year ago, United said, adding that revenue passenger miles totalled 78.39 billion, compared to 74.68 billion a year ago.
